shortDescription: This module configures and manages Fibre Channel (FC) partnership on IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: backgroundcopyrate
options.description: Specifies the maximum percentage of aggregate link bandwidth that can be used for background copy operations. The value must be in the range of 0 - 100. The default value is 50. Valid when I(state=present).

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: linkbandwidthmbits
options.description: Specifies the aggregate bandwidth of the remote copy link between two clustered systems (systems) in megabits per second (Mbps). The value must be in the range of 1 - 100000. Valid when I(state=present).

options.name: log_path
options.description: Path of debug log file.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: pbrinuse
options.description: Specifies whether policy-based replication will be used on the partnership. Valid when I(state=present) to update a partnership.

options.name: remote_clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the remote Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: remote_domain
options.description: Domain for the remote Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(remote_clustername).

options.name: remote_password
options.description: REST API password for the remote Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(remote_username) and I(remote_password) are required if not using I(remote_token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: remote_system
options.description: Specifies the partner system ID or name.

options.name: remote_token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the remote Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.spectrum_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: remote_username
options.description: REST API username for the remote Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(remote_username) and I(remote_password) are required if not using I(remote_token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: remote_validate_certs
options.description: Validates certification for the remote Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: start
options.description: Specifies to start a partnership. Valid when I(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: Creates or updates (C(present)) or removes (C(absent)) a FC partnership.

options.name: stop
options.description: Specifies to stop a partnership. Valid when I(state=present) to update a partnership.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.spectrum_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validates certification for the local Spectrum Virtualize storage system.
